summary: I run Total Transformation, three months of group coaching for people who know they're capable of more and are tired of starting over every Monday. We work on the thinking and choices underneath your habits, one change at a time.
audience: Anyone, man or woman, at a turning point and ready for a change: people who've spent years putting everyone else first, people who've retired, people juggling work and family. It's closest to my heart for women at every stage of life.
problem:
Before: "I know what to do. I just don't do it." They've been last on their own list for a long time, they're not sure what they want anymore, and they start over every Monday.
After: they're clear on their goals and which direction they want to go next. They believe in themselves more, handle stress better, and the changes last past Monday.
moments:
They've just retired.
The house has gone quiet.
They're juggling work and family and starting over every Monday.
They realize they've spent years putting everyone else first and don't know what they want anymore.
offerings:
Total Transformation Coaching: my three months of group coaching, through Sheila Sherman LLC
Sheila's half-day workshop, for people who can't take on three months right now
howItRuns:
Three months, in a group.
Each session mixes some teaching, honest talk with the group and a practical exercise you take into your week. We look at how mindset, choices, habits, stress, relationships and goals connect, then change one thing at a time.
The free call is 15 minutes with the NowTRANSFORMED team. After the call: if it's a fit, the team goes through joining the group with you, including the cost.
faqs:
Q: Is this a weight-loss program?
A: No. It's coaching on mindset and habits. Your health is part of that, but it isn't a diet.

Q: I've tried everything. Why would this be different?
A: Most plans tell you what to do. We work on why you don't do it.

Q: I don't have time for three months.
A: Then start with my half-day workshop. Ask about the next date on your free call.

Q: I'm not a group person.
A: That's fair. Ask on the free call how the group works before you decide anything.

Q: Is it only for women?
A: No. It's for anyone, man or woman, who's at a turning point and ready for a change.
aboutYou:
A few years before I turned 62, I was struggling with my own health. I know what it feels like to know you need to change and to wonder if you can really do it. What helped me was deciding to put myself back on my own priority list. At 62 I became a certified personal trainer.
Transformation isn't simply about changing your body. It begins with changing the way you think, the choices you make, and the way you show up for yourself.
Today I'm also a transformation specialist and sugar detox coach, and I co-own a Hotworx fitness studio with my daughter. My greatest qualification is my own transformation.
mustNotSay:
No prices on the page.
No medical claims or diagnoses, and no promises about health results.
Don't call it a weight-loss program or a diet. It's coaching on mindset and habits.
Don't promise a set result by the end of the three months.
